title: is it ...? have you ...? do they ...? etc. (questions 1)
summary: Как задавать вопросы: вспомогательный или модальный глагол ставим **перед** подлежащим (**Is it ...? Can you ...?**), а для обычных глаголов добавляем **do / does / did**.
ru:
## Порядок слов в вопросе
В утверждении подлежащее стоит первым: **You are eating.** В вопросе первый глагол (am/is/are, have, will, can ...) выходит **вперёд**, перед подлежащим.
> You are eating. → **Are you** eating? — Ты ешь?
> That seat is free. → **Is that seat** free? — Это место свободно?
> She was angry. → Why **was she** angry? — Почему она была сердита?
> David has gone. → Where **has David** gone? — Куда ушёл Дэвид?
> They will be here soon. → When **will they** be here? — Когда они будут здесь?
> Paula can swim. → **Can Paula** swim? — Паула умеет плавать?
В русском порядок обычно не меняется, а вопрос выражается интонацией. В английском порядок слов **обязательно** меняется.

## Подлежащее после первого глагола
> Where **has David gone**? (не ~~Where has gone David?~~)
> **Are those people waiting** for something? (не ~~Are waiting those people?~~)
> When **was the telephone invented**? (не ~~When was invented the telephone?~~)

## Вопросы с do / does / did
У обычных глаголов (work, live, like, go ...) вопрос образуется с помощью **do, does, did**.
- настоящее: **Do** I / we / you / they ...? **Does** he / she / it ...?
- прошедшее: **Did** + любое подлежащее ...?
После них — **начальная форма** глагола.
> You work in a bank. → **Do you work** in a bank? — Ты работаешь в банке?
> Sue likes tea. → **Does Sue like** tea? — Сью любит чай?
> They left early. → **Did they leave** early? — Они ушли рано?
> What time **do you get up**? — Во сколько ты встаёшь?
> Where **did you go**? — Куда ты ходил?

## Do / does / did нужны не всегда
С **be, have got, can, will, must, should** do **не нужен**: сами меняют место.
> ~~Do you are tired?~~ → **Are you** tired?
> ~~Does she can swim?~~ → **Can she** swim?

## Вопросительное слово + вспомогательный глагол
What / Where / When / Why / How + вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее + глагол.
> What **do you** want? — Чего ты хочешь?
> Where **is she** going? — Куда она идёт?
> How **did they** get here? — Как они сюда добрались?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~You are tired?~~ → **Are you** tired?
- ~~Do you can swim?~~ → **Can you** swim?
- ~~Does she likes tea?~~ → Does she **like** tea?
- ~~Where you did go?~~ → Where **did you go**?
- ~~What means this word?~~ → What **does** this word **mean**?
en:
## Word order in questions
In a positive sentence the subject comes first: **You are eating.** In a question the first verb (am/is/are, have, will, can ...) goes **before** the subject.
> You are eating. → **Are you** eating?
> That seat is free. → **Is that seat** free?
> She was angry. → Why **was she** angry?
> David has gone. → Where **has David** gone?
> They will be here soon. → When **will they** be here?
> Paula can swim. → **Can Paula** swim?

## The subject comes after the first verb
> Where **has David gone**? (not ~~Where has gone David?~~)
> **Are those people waiting** for something?
> When **was the telephone invented**?

## Questions with do / does / did
With ordinary verbs (work, live, like, go ...) we use **do, does, did**.
- present: **Do** I / we / you / they ...? **Does** he / she / it ...?
- past: **Did** + any subject ...?
After them we use the **base form**.
> You work in a bank. → **Do you work** in a bank?
> Sue likes tea. → **Does Sue like** tea?
> They left early. → **Did they leave** early?
> What time **do you get up**?
> Where **did you go**?

## We don't always need do / does / did
With **be, have got, can, will, must, should** we don't use do.
> ~~Do you are tired?~~ → **Are you** tired?
> ~~Does she can swim?~~ → **Can she** swim?

## Question word + auxiliary verb
What / Where / When / Why / How + auxiliary + subject + verb.
> What **do you** want?
> Where **is she** going?
> How **did they** get here?

## Common mistakes
- ~~You are tired?~~ → **Are you** tired?
- ~~Do you can swim?~~ → **Can you** swim?
- ~~Does she likes tea?~~ → Does she **like** tea?
- ~~Where you did go?~~ → Where **did you go**?
structure:
## Вопросы без do
| Утверждение | Вопрос |
|---|---|
| I am late. | Am I late? |
| It is raining. | Is it raining? |
| She was ill. | Was she ill? |
| You have got a pen. | Have you got a pen? |
| They will come. | Will they come? |
| He can swim. | Can he swim? |

## Вопросы с do / does / did
| Время | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Настоящее | Do + I/we/you/they + глагол? | Do you live here? |
| Настоящее | Does + he/she/it + глагол? | Does he work? |
| Прошедшее | Did + подлежащее + глагол? | Did they call? |

## С вопросительным словом
| Вопросительное слово | + | Вспомогательный | + | Подлежащее | + | Глагол |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| What | | do | | you | | want? |
| Where | | is | | she | | going? |
| When | | did | | they | | arrive? |
| Why | | has | | he | | gone? |

## Краткие ответы
> Are you tired? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
> Do you like it? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
> Did she call? — Yes, she did. / No, she didn't.
> Can he swim? — Yes, he can. / No, he can't.

## Запомните
- **be, have, can, will** сами выходят перед подлежащим;
- **do/does/did** + начальная форма (не ~~likes~~, не ~~went~~);
- порядок: **вопросительное слово → вспомогательный → подлежащее → глагол**.

exercises.title: Сделайте вопрос
exercises.instruction: Допишите вопрос: поставьте вспомогательный глагол перед подлежащим.

items.text: She is a doctor. → {{Is she}} a doctor?
You have got a sister. → {{Have you}} got a sister?
He can speak French. → {{Can he}} speak French?
It will rain tomorrow. → {{Will it}} rain tomorrow?
Tom has gone home. → Where {{has Tom}} gone?
What time {{did}} you get up yesterday?
How often {{do}} you go to the gym?

items.why: Подлежащее после первого глагола: **has Tom gone**.

answers: What time does the film start?
What time does the film begin?
Why did she go home early yesterday?
Why did she go home early?
When is she going to come?

exercises.title: Напишите вопросы
exercises.instruction: Придумайте вопросы другу (по подсказкам). Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: Ask about his or her job
items.sample: What do you do? / Where do you work?

items.prompt: Ask about his or her free time
items.sample: What do you do in your free time?

items.prompt: Ask what he or she did yesterday
Ask if he or she can cook
Ask where he or she is from
